personas.scenario_note: New learner assigned Account Support Fundamentals

showcase.label: New learner
showcase.headline: Use Nora to test AI Onboarding.

features.text: Learn Account Support Fundamentals with the AI tutor, by voice or text
Check questions, hints and saved progress
Sources from the approved escalation guide beside the chat

personas.scenario_note: Queue shift lead; moving off priority-account escalation

showcase.label: Queue shift lead
showcase.headline: Use Leo to test the lead's side.

Publish the handover to the Evening shift
Hand over priority-account escalation before a role change

showcase.label: Support agent and successor
showcase.headline: Use Mia to test a team member's day.

features.text: Your cases, guidance from the approved guide, report progress, resolve in the case system

personas.scenario_note: Reviews knowledge and packages; confirms transfers

features.text: Review knowledge notes and KT packages before they become shared knowledge
Browse the approved curricula and sources

personas.scenario_note: Lead for the next Morning shift, with Nora Santos

showcase.headline: Use Cora to test a lead who's off shift.

features.text: Read the published handovers between shifts
Lead actions (assigning, delegating, publishing) wait until the Morning shift starts

personas.scenario_note: Evening shift lead after Leo Cruz, with Mia Reyes
